key_insight: ReDiPPO improves mathematical reasoning by using reference answers to calibrate value estimates and by reweighting token-level advantages where the standard critic disagrees most with the reference-guided critic.
engineering_relevance: The method targets a core RL bottleneck for long-horizon reasoning: noisy token credit assignment under sparse rewards, which can improve training stability and final model accuracy.
method: Reference-guided critic uses training-time answer references to produce more accurate value estimates.
Standard critic remains in place, and its discrepancy from the reference-guided critic marks difficult reasoning states.
Token-level advantages are reweighted during PPO updates based on this discrepancy.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where ReDiPPO improves value-estimation accuracy and outperforms PPO, DAPO, and GSPO in final reasoning performance.
watch_item: Because the approach relies on reference answers during training, performance may depend on access to high-quality supervision and careful handling of train-test mismatch.
paper_title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
